# VRFBuildSettingsEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Build` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Build/VRFBuildSettingsEditor.cs#L19)

Draws the VRF settings of one build profile: one collapsible section per setting, the
problems they add up to, and the menu that adds another.

Used both by the Inspector, when the settings sub-asset is selected under its profile,
and by [`VRFBuildWindow`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-build/VRFBuildWindow), which hosts this same editor. Neither one knows
which settings exist - the sections come from whatever the profile carries.

```csharp
[CustomEditor(typeof(VRFBuildSettings))]
public class VRFBuildSettingsEditor : Editor
```
